annotations.title: Search Spain Public Tenders & Awards (PLACSP Contratación)

description: Parse Spain's official Plataforma de Contratación del Sector Público (PLACSP CODICE Atom feeds) into clean JSON: open public tenders (`licitaciones`), minor contracts (`contratos menores`), CPV codes, EUR budgets, and winning NIF contract awards (`corridordata/spain-public-tenders-contratacion`).

cpvPrefixes.description: CPV code prefixes (e.g. ['72'] for IT/Software, ['79'] for Consulting, ['45'] for Construction).

feedType.description: General contracting profiles (`licitaciones`) or SME minor contracts (`contratos_menores`).

keywords.description: Spanish or English keywords matched against contract title or authority.

maxItems.description: Maximum Spanish public tender or award notices to return.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Optional per-run USD spend cap forwarded to Apify Pay-Per-Event billing (`maxTotalChargeUsd`).

region.description: Optional city, province, or Autonomous Community substring (e.g. 'Madrid', 'Barcelona').

statusFilter.description: Filter for open tenders (`open_only`), awarded contracts (`awarded_only`), or all.

name: search_spain_public_tenders
